kcc_query_text_example: Marginal dryland tomato farmer with 1.2 acres in Bangarapet, Kolar; suffered complete crop loss and price collapse where tomatoes fetched ₹2/kg against ₹12/kg cost of cultivation; facing severe household distress and mounting input dealer debt; urgently seeking non-repayable income support and DBT relief under PM-KISAN.

statutory_flags.tenure_documentation: RTC registered pre-February 2019 in Bangarapet taluk

attribute_provenance.empirical_baseline: APMC Kolar market arrivals & NSS 77th Round: Extreme tomato price volatility in Kolar district causing severe farmer distress when farmgate prices crash below transportation costs.
attribute_provenance.farmer_query_inspiration: KCC Karnataka distress calls: Marginal farmers in severe financial distress requesting immediate government cash relief and DBT payments.
attribute_provenance.statutory_policy_test: Benchmark Challenge 2: Relief vs. Reimbursable Debt; farmer requests non-repayable income support due to market collapse distress; Protocol v1.1 Rule 2 mandates that reimbursable production credit (KCC-MISS) must NOT receive clinical score 3; PM-KISAN directly matches need for non-repayable cash assistance (score 3); Krishi Bhagya qualifies on dryland holding (1.2 ac); PM-KUSUM B disqualified due to lack of water source; Ganga Kalyana disqualified due to General Merit social category mismatch; PMFBY raw engine returns ELIGIBLE for tomato, but governance routes to Section B as REQUIRES_VERIFICATION pending Kharif 2026 Insurance Unit notification verification.

intended_test_purpose: Evaluate Challenge 2 (Relief vs. Debt) clinical recommendation protocol; confirm PM-KISAN eligibility for non-repayable income support; verify exclusion of credit from score 3; route PMFBY to Section B pending seasonal notification verification.
unresolved_dependencies: Market Intervention Scheme (MIS) notification: State/Central price deficiency payment or market intervention for tomato in Kolar district during price crash events
PM-KISAN e-KYC and NPCI bank account Aadhaar-seeding operational verification
Verification of GoK Kharif 2026 PMFBY/RWBCIS Insurance Unit (Gram Panchayat/Hobli level) notification for Tomato in Kolar district (Bangarapet taluk)
